sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Overpopulation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Mercenary, I have a job for you. At the former USEC base belonging to your associates in the chalet area at Cape Dalniy, a large amount of valuable equipment and information was left behind after the conflict. This could help fund our operations. But there is one problem: the entire area is currently under enemy control. We need to eliminate them permanently, or at least temporarily remove the threat. While you are there, search the location for documents and bring them to me. That is your task, my friend. Naturally, everything you have heard will remain between us. I await your report."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate any 10 targets around the chalets on Lighthouse
- Hand over 5 Topographic survey maps, Intelligence folder, or TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials marked with the Found in raid status

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
- 1,900 Dollars
  - 1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"My observers have already informed me of your work, mercenary. I believe you have earned a generous reward."
